title.suggested: Criminologist says Barrington, proud of Allen's silk hat, may be insane

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch printed a criminologist's view that "Lord" Barrington, accused of the McCann murder, acted like a lunatic, citing his passion for dead men's clothes and his pride in owning Tom Allen's silk hat.
